meta.what: Harry Potter creatures and named individual creatures
meta.denominator: Harry Potter wiki: every namespace-0 page that carries a Creature infobox (819 pages, harrypotter_pages_current), union by title
meta.split_rule: Rows are ordered by sha1 of "nextcells-v1:<id>"; those whose first hex byte is below 0x40 are the tuning sample, the only rows the prompt or normaliser may be adjusted on; every other row is held out and reported. Dial: seed and fraction; the fixed seed is the reported one.

class_map.baseline: majority class among labelled held-out rows (computed at build)

meta.label: the Ministry of Magic classification X to XXXXX (the infobox class field, counted X; 125 of 819 pages state one; hidden). Beings, spirits and unrated pages have no X label and are not scored
meta.fold_rule: A guessed class becomes a sheet field only where held-out hits beat the majority baseline over the labelled held-out rows (PWC2); otherwise the sheet drops it and the note says model tier, unchecked.

score.label: the Ministry of Magic classification X to XXXXX (the infobox class field, counted X; 125 of 819 pages state one; hidden). Beings, spirits and unrated pages have no X label and are not scored
